sprint: Planned Example Completion Gap Analysis and Full-Coverage Generation Design

cells.needed_for_full_coverage: Already at 100% of runnable types. No action needed. Cells could potentially demonstrate advanced patterns (e.g., custom SaveOptionsProvider implementations) in future, but those are not standalone examples.
cells.fixture_api_403_impact: GitHub API 403 blocked 20/22 fixture lookups without GITHUB_TOKEN. However, all 9 published examples use programmatic input (template_hints.input_creation_lines), not fixture files. The fixture API gap did not block any Cells scenarios.

excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: Compare(v1, v2, output, author, dateTime) needs 2 input fixture files. No paired fixture generation strategy exists. template_hints has merger_input_creation_lines for 2 files, but Comparer needs 2 DIFFERENT documents to compare.
MailMerger.Execute(template, output, fieldNames, fieldValues) needs a DOCX template with merge field placeholders whose names are known. No merge-field-aware fixture strategy exists.
Merger.Merge(output, inputFiles[]) needs 2+ input files. merger_input_creation_lines exist in words.yml but planner does not pass them to scenarios requiring array inputs.
Processor uses a builder pattern: new Processor().From().To().Execute(). This is not the standard static-method pattern. The planner and prompt system do not support builder-pattern APIs.
ReportBuilder.BuildReport(template, output, data) needs a DOCX template with LINQ Reporting Engine tags AND matching data. No template-with-data fixture strategy exists.

additional_blocker.description: Splitter.Split(SplitOptions) needs SplitCriteria enum values, which are not in the DllReflector catalog. The current Splitter.ExtractPages workaround is published, but Splitter.Split remains blocked.
additional_blocker.impacts: WORDS-005 — an advanced Splitter scenario using SplitOptions

system_gaps: No paired fixture strategy (blocks Comparer, Merger)
No builder-pattern API support in planner/prompt (blocks Processor)
No SplitCriteria enum enumeration in DllReflector (blocks Splitter.Split advanced scenario)
No automated DOCX semantic validation (non-blocking but limits quality assurance)
words.needed_for_full_coverage: Close 4 system gaps: paired fixture strategy, mail-merge template fixture, ReportBuilder template, builder-pattern support. Then expand allowlist to include Comparer, MailMerger, Merger, ReportBuilder, Processor.

backlogged_types.detail: LLM consistently generates 'new PluginOptions()' instead of 'new SplitOptions()'. PluginOptions is abstract. Code validator (line 549) catches this but only AFTER generation. No pre-generation few-shot example or prompt constraint specific to SplitOptions.
Same PluginOptions hallucination as Splitter. Additionally, LLM repair timed out (120s timeout, no retry). Compound failure: wrong class + infrastructure timeout.

system_gaps: No SplitOptions/OptimizeOptions few-shot examples in LLM prompt

Code validator catches PluginOptions AFTER generation but repair prompt does not specifically guide toward correct concrete class

pdf.needed_for_full_coverage: 1) Fix Splitter/Optimizer (few-shot + validator). 2) Add format-specific output validators. 3) Add complex fixture strategies. 4) Progressively expand allowlist in batches of 3-5 types. 5) Add LLM timeout retry.
